options.name: Blocked
options.description: Waits on another issue or a decision

options.name: Critical
options.description: Blocks the release or a core flow. No workaround. Fix now.

options.name: High
options.description: Breaks a major function for many users. Workaround is painful. Fix within days.

options.name: Medium
options.description: Affects some users or has a reasonable workaround. Schedule it.

options.name: Low
options.description: Cosmetic or small cleanup. No schedule pressure.

options.name: L
